---
title: "R Notebook Covariance Matrix"
output: html_notebook
---

This is the code provided in the assignment. 
```{r}
library(MASS)

gen_data<-function(n) {
  p<-3
  n1<-n2<-n/2
  cov_1<-diag(rep(1,p))+0.2
  cov_2<-cov_1
  cov_2[1,2]<-cov_2[2,1]<-cov_2[1,2]+0.5
  x_class1<-mvrnorm(n1,mu=rep(3,p),Sigma= cov_1)
  x_class2<-mvrnorm(n2,mu=rep(2,p),Sigma= cov_2)
  x<-rbind(x_class1, x_class2)
  y<-rep(c(1,2),c(n1, n2))
  df<-as.data.frame(cbind(x,y))
  names(df)<-c(paste0("x",1:p),"y")
  return(df)
  }
```

This is the generation of data portion. 
```{r}
train_set_1_50_samples <- gen_data(50)
train_set_2_10000_samples <- gen_data(10000)
test_set_1_10000_samples <- gen_data(10000)

train_set_1_50_samples
train_set_2_10000_samples
test_set_1_10000_samples
```

A linear discriminant and quadratic discriminant model is trained using 50 samples

```{r}
linear_discrimant_model <- lda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_1_50_samples)
quadratic_discriminant_model <- qda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_1_50_samples)
```

LDA and QDA is used to predict classifications of 10000 test samples
```{r}
lda_classifications <- predict(linear_discrimant_model, test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes <- lda_classifications$class
qda_classifications <- predict(quadratic_discriminant_model,test_set_1_10000_samples)
qda_classes <- qda_classifications$class

```

The performance is measured by comparing lda and qda classes with actual labels.
```{r}
lda_performance = mean(lda_classes == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])
qda_performance = mean(qda_classes == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])
```

Accuracy is printed
```{r}
cat("LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lda_performance, "\n")
cat("QDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", qda_performance, "\n")
```

Linear discriminant and quadratic discriminant are trained using 10000 samples and classes from test set are predicted accordingly. 
```{r}
linear_discrimant_model_large <- lda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)
quadratic_discriminant_model_large <- qda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)
lda_classifications_large <- predict(linear_discrimant_model_large, test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes_large <- lda_classifications_large$class
qda_classifications_large <- predict(quadratic_discriminant_model_large,test_set_1_10000_samples)
qda_classes_large <- qda_classifications_large$class
lda_performance_large = mean(lda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])
qda_performance_large = mean(qda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])

cat("LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", lda_performance_large, "\n")
cat("QDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set:", qda_performance_large, "\n")
```

The average accuracy is calculated over 100 runs for the large train set. 
```{r}
lda_100_accuracies <- numeric(100)
qda_100_accuracies <- numeric(100)


for (i in 1:100) {
linear_discrimant_model_large <- lda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)
quadratic_discriminant_model_large <- qda(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = train_set_2_10000_samples)
  
lda_classifications_large <- predict(linear_discrimant_model_large, test_set_1_10000_samples)
lda_classes_large <- lda_classifications_large$class
qda_classifications_large <- predict(quadratic_discriminant_model_large, test_set_1_10000_samples)
  qda_classes_large <- qda_classifications_large$class
  
  lda_performance_large = mean(lda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])
  qda_performance_large = mean(qda_classes_large == test_set_1_10000_samples[["y"]])
  
  lda_100_accuracies[i] <- lda_performance_large
  qda_100_accuracies[i] <- qda_performance_large
}

average_over_100_lda_accuracy <- mean(lda_100_accuracies)
average_over_100_qda_accuracy <- mean(qda_100_accuracies)

cat("Average LDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set over 100 runs:", average_over_100_lda_accuracy, "\n")
cat("Average QDA performance in terms of accuracy on test set over 100 runs:", average_over_100_qda_accuracy, "\n")

```
